entities.title: clean::shrink has no caller left
entities.summary: Since the MCP proxy and `zazzle run` moved to clean::shrink_steps, clean::shrink is called only by its own test, and its comment still names the proxy as its caller.
entities.compromise: shrink was kept beside the new shrink_steps (which also returns the steps, so callers can tell whether anything was cut) instead of being removed; its comment says it is for "callers other than the command line such as the MCP proxy", which no longer holds.
entities.cost: A public function and a test to keep in step with clean, and a comment that points a reader at a caller that does not use it.
acceptanceCriteria: clean::shrink is removed with its test, or has a caller again and a comment that names it.
`cargo test -p daemon` and the branch-coverage gate still pass.

origin.by: Coding agent reconciling the daemon .dev files with commit 5ea503c

entities.title: Measure a trigram index for find on macOS
entities.summary: shell-tools' trigram index was dropped when it merged into the daemon because on Linux it saved about 40 ms per search only on an 18,000-file tree, at about 170 MB and a 1.7 s build; macOS, where stat and reads cost differently, was not measured.
acceptanceCriteria: find's mean time over 20 different patterns on a large tree (such as ~/.cargo/registry/src) is measured on an Apple Silicon Mac with and without an index (git history: src/macos/shell-tools/src/index.rs before the merge), with resident memory.
An index is added to find only if it wins by more than its memory and build stall are worth, and a decision record says why either way.

origin.by: Coding agent merging shell-tools into the daemon
